score_replay.boundary: Retained AUC values are reused after validating sample counts, protocol parameters, and every draw's deterministic twist hash, term count and sign counts. Summaries and interpretation are regenerated. Raw FGM inputs and original scoring are not rerun; the source digest binds the reused measurements.

intervening_maps: Catalog timestamps and the label window map each admitted daily FGM six-sample window to a binary crossing label.
Each four-lag window maps Bx, By, Bz and derived |B| to 16 staple coordinates.
Three overlapping staples map six FGM samples to a cubic associator contraction and its Euclidean norm, divided by the original triple norm product plus 1e-30.
A seeded per-file subsample keeps every positive and independently samples negatives; the full-sample arm retains all labels.
Pooled average-rank Mann-Whitney reduction maps scores and labels to ROC-AUC, followed by ensemble quantiles and canonical comparisons.
preregistration.hypothesis: The Cayley-Dickson sedenion associator tensor's benchmark performance is specific relative to (1) the negative-control normalized-cocycle family, (2) the 35-line basis-alternative twist ensemble on PG(3, 2), and (3) its own algebra-isomorphic relabeling orbit under GL(4, Z_2) automorphisms.
preregistration.control_family_cocycle: n_cocycles normalized 2-cocycles sigma(i,j) = (-1)^{i^T B j} tau(i) tau(j) tau(i ^ j) with B in GF(2)^{4x4}, tau(0)=+1; associator vanishes identically.
preregistration.control_family_invariant_twist: n_invariant_twists unital, anticommutative, basis-alternative twists with imaginary squares -1, parameterized by fair orientation signs on the 35 projective lines of PG(3, 2). Support is not matched to the canonical 1848-term tensor.
preregistration.orbit_family_isomorphic: n_isomorphic_orbits draws from the GL(4, Z_2) x (Z_2)^15 algebra-isomorphic relabeling orbit: sigma_{pi, s}(i, j) = s_i s_j s_{i ^ j} sigma_0(pi(i), pi(j)), preserving 1848-term cardinality and 924/924 sign balance. GL relabelings can move nonzero coordinate triples, so the orbit is not support-matched.
falsifiers: False if any normalized 2-cocycle has non-zero associator terms or non-chance AUC.
False if canonical CD AUC is at or below the 97.5th percentile of the 35-line basis-alternative twist ensemble.
The isomorphic orbit reports the coordinate-relabeling sensitivity of the sedenion associator; specificity fails if canonical AUC is at or below that orbit's 97.5th percentile.
preregistration.seed_policy: ChaCha8; zero-based draw index d; all seed additions and multiplications wrap modulo 2^64. Cocycle d uses seed 42 + (d+1)*0x517CC1B727220A95; invariant twist d uses seed 42 + (d+1)*0x9E3779B97F4A7C15; isomorphic orbit d uses seed 42 + (d+10001)*0x9E3779B97F4A7C15; subsample keeps every positive and each negative with probability 0.05 from ChaCha8(seed XOR file_id*0x9E3779B97F4A7C15)
